annual_rules_effective: 2026-12-01; enacted rules applying to 2026 annual income; monthly withholding through November unchanged
future_rule_basis: 2026 law nominally frozen for the 2026-2055 diagnostic; not a forecast of enacted sunset or future CPI tax reforms
N3_30_including_or_excluding_surtax: UNDECIDED; common-scope 2x2 retains surcharge for A/B/C/D; ordinary-only columns bridge to SPE's 30% gross amount

deduction_boundaries.PERSONAL_ONLY_KEEP_CREDITS: Remove income deductions; preserve salary income deduction/income adjustment or blue-return income calculation; preserve tax credit
deduction_boundaries.INCLUDING_EARNED_INCOME_KEEP_CREDITS: Also remove salary income deduction, income adjustment, blue-return special deduction; preserve actual business expenses and tax credits
deduction_boundaries.INCLUDING_EARNED_INCOME_DROP_CREDITS: Same, and remove tax credits; income tax 30% plus common surcharge is a diagnostic not adopted N3 all-in rate

profile_assumptions: All households are set to each profile in turn; not an observed joint distribution or national tax estimate. Social insurance 15% is supplied deductible-payment sensitivity, not statutory universal contribution rate. Other income=0. Credit100k is a representative conditional stress only.
rounding: salary table as 2026 NTA annual table; taxable income floor1000yen; surcharge floor1yen; liability before withholding settlement, optional annual floor100yen column
business_expenses: Never abolished. Business input=profit after actual necessary expenses, before blue special deduction.
omitted_or_zero_by_condition: other income deductions not applicable or supplied zero
spouse special deduction when spouse has income
special relative deduction when relative has income
capital-gains high-income minimum tax above330million yen (outside tested range)
